source_review.zip_integrity: Original compressed ZIP bytes are retained unchanged and require API size+SHA equality before parsing. Whole table is preflighted before extraction: reject absolute/traversal/backslash/colon/NUL/noncanonical/empty-dot paths, duplicate normalized file-directory names, ancestor collisions, symlink/special/mismatched types, encryption and nonempty directories. Every member including excluded history and directories is streamed to EOF for CRC/length/SHA with finite bounds; complete member metadata/classifications are recorded.
source_review.selective_extraction: Only after every ZIP member passes integrity checks is a second extraction pass allowed. Fresh output root, nonredirected resolved parents and exclusive files avoid overwrite. Selected bytes are streamed and rechecked against first-pass length/SHA; historical/unknown/opaque members are not copied out. dSYM/xcresult/AAB/mappings remain original ZIP custody, not discarded or relabeled.

Failed/corrupt collection does not erase previously downloaded compressed evidence or imply remaining artifacts were collected.
